title: Vocabulary: Education
objective: Know the core words for school, studying and exams — a very common PET topic.

items.meaning: to complete a degree or course; a person who has completed one
items.example: She graduated from university last year.

items.meaning: to study again before an exam
items.example: I need to revise my history notes tonight.
items.exampleZh: 今晚我得复习历史笔记。

items.meaning: something you study at school, e.g. maths, history
items.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的科目是地理。

items.meaning: one of the periods into which a school year is divided
items.example: The new term starts in September.
I'm taking my English exam next week.
He passed all his exams with good marks.
items.exampleZh: 他所有考试都考得很好。

items.meaning: to not succeed in an exam
items.example: She failed her driving test twice.
items.exampleZh: 她驾照考试考了两次都没过。

items.example: The teacher gave us a lot of homework.
items.exampleZh: 老师给了我们很多作业。

items.example: My brother goes to the secondary school near the park.
items.exampleZh: 我哥哥在公园附近的中学上学。

items.example: She wants to get a degree in medicine.

items.meaning: a talk given to university students
items.example: The lecture on ancient Rome was fascinating.
items.exampleZh: 那堂关于古罗马的课很精彩。

items.example: You'll make progress if you practise every day.

items.meaning: school for young children, usually aged 5–11
items.example: My little sister is still at primary school.

items.meaning: a list of lessons or classes and the times they happen
items.example: We have maths twice a week on our timetable.
items.exampleZh: 根据课程表，我们每周上两次数学。

items.meaning: a number or letter showing how well someone did
items.example: She got top marks in her English test.
items.exampleZh: 她在英语考试中得了最高分。

items.meaning: an official document that proves you have completed something
items.example: You get a certificate when you finish the course.
items.exampleZh: 课程结束后你会得到一张证书。

items.meaning: an exam you have passed or an official skill that makes you suitable for work
items.example: Good qualifications give you more job choices.
items.exampleZh: 好的资历能给你更多工作选择。

items.meaning: a child who goes to school
items.example: There are about 400 pupils at the school.
items.exampleZh: 这所学校大约有四百名学生。

keyPoints: Learn each word with its example sentence — context is what PET tests.
Say the word aloud, then use it in your own sentence about your life.
Review these words in the flashcard system until they reach mastered.
